documentation.accessibilityText:
CANONICAL REQUIREMENTS

Accessibility contract
Run component QA →
NATIVE SEMANTICS

Prefer native form controls and preserve labels, descriptions, errors, disabled fieldsets, reset, and validation.

KEYBOARD

Tab, Shift+Tab, Enter, Space, ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home, End, composition

FOCUS

Visible Input Focus, Error Focus Policy, Caret And Selection Preservation

WCAG REFERENCES

1.3.1, 1.3.5, 2.1.1, 2.4.3, 2.4.7, 2.5.8, 3.3.1, 3.3.2, 3.3.3, 4.1.2, 4.1.3

These requirements come from the canonical Switch catalog entry. Application copy, labels, custom styling, and composed workflows still require product-level testing.

documentation.usageCode:
<script lang="ts">
  import {
    SwitchRoot,
    SwitchControl,
    SwitchThumb,
    SwitchLabel,
    SwitchHiddenInput,
  } from '@uifn/components-svelte/switch'
  import '@uifn/components/styles.css'
</script>

<SwitchRoot defaultChecked name="darkMode">
  <SwitchControl type="button">
    <SwitchThumb />
  </SwitchControl>
  <SwitchLabel>Automatic updates</SwitchLabel>
  <SwitchHiddenInput />
</SwitchRoot>
